summary: Shows seealso formats (module, plugin with plugin_type, ref anchor with optional title, external link with name) and introduces the attributes field, usually supplied by fragments like action_common_attributes.
questions: How do I add a link to another module in seealso?
How do I reference a lookup plugin in seealso?
Why is my seealso ref link broken?
What are module attributes and where do they come from?

answer_card.title: seealso formats and attributes
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
seealso:
  - module: cisco.aci.aci_tenant
    description: ACI module to create tenants.
  - plugin: ansible.builtin.file
    plugin_type: lookup
  - ref: The official Ansible ACI guide <aci_guide>
    description: ...
  - name: APIC MIM reference
    description: ...
    link: https://developer.cisco.com/docs/apic-mim-ref/
```
If `ref:` points to an anchor without a title, include a title. `attributes` maps names to descriptions, typically from fragments like `ansible.builtin.action_common_attributes`.
